newsitem.title: MEXICO: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Friday steer calves and yearlings exported to the United States from Mexico sold steady to three cents/lb higher than last week.
Exports for the week were estimated at 9,500 head into Texas and New Mexico. Confirmed exports for the previous week totaled 6,036 head, against 4,238 head in the same week in 1996.
"Trade moderate to active, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of medium and large 1&2 steers weighing 300-600 lbs," the USDA said.
Prices for medium and large 1 feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 95-105 cents/lb, for 400-500 lb 85-95 cents/lb and 500-600 lb 80-85 cents/lb.
About 2700 head of slaughter were exported from the United States to Mexico for the week, it added.
